visual.general_description: Two grayscale cross-sectional images, each with a red arrow, labelled A and B.
visual.detailed_description: Two side-by-side grayscale images separated by a thin vertical line. Panel A (left) has a black irregular vertical channel with a red arrow pointing to a rounded gray area beside it; panel B (right) has a large black area above a smaller black oval with a red arrow pointing to a rounded gray protrusion at the margin of the large black area. Both show mid-gray soft tissue with bright white shapes. Panel letters A and B are white at the lower left of each panel.

panels.general_description: Grayscale cross-sectional image with a red arrow pointing to a rounded gray area beside a black air-filled channel.
panels.detailed_description: Square-ish grayscale panel with a thin black border and a white letter A at the lower left. A black irregular vertical channel with a smaller separate black round spot to its right lies in the center. Mid-gray soft-tissue texture surrounds them. A bright white curved band runs across the upper part, and bright white elongated shapes lie near the left and right sides of the middle. A small bright white round spot lies below the channel near the bottom center. A red arrow in the lower center points up and to the left toward a rounded slightly darker gray area adjacent to the black channel. A curved gray band outlines the lower edge, and parts of another gray structure appear at the very bottom edge. No printed numbers, scale bars or measurement text are visible.
